title: STORY-015 Leadership Dashboard: evidence
capturedBy: scripts/evidence/story-003-015.mjs on a local copy of the deployed code
summary: STORY-015 works on the demo deployment, with synthetic data; it is not operating in production. A leadership user (a director) sees how the program is doing, never who is in it: total applications, approval rate, average processing time, open cases and appeal rate; applications and decisions per week for 12 weeks; bottlenecks (average days in each stage, from the case timelines, and how many cases are stuck in each for more than 5 days); and team performance by case manager.
Aggregates only: no applicant names, emails or other personal data reach this page or its API. Leadership does no case work: the case pages, the audit log and the admin dashboard refuse it.
checks: Evidence run, local: the leadership figures name no applicant (API and page); processing takes days as laid out (6.5 days on average); no case-work links show; Riley is refused the staff case statistics, the audit log and the admin dashboard (403 each).
API end to end, local (scripts/e2e/dashboards.mjs): the leadership output contains no applicant email or name; KPIs and week buckets move as cases are decided.
Accessibility: the leadership /dashboard and an admin's /leadership pass the WCAG 2.1 AA checks. Each chart is an image with a description, followed by a table with the same numbers.

shots.title: Riley's leadership dashboard
shots.caption: KPIs, applications and decisions per week (chart and table), bottlenecks by stage, and team performance. No applicant is named anywhere on the page.

notes: Case manager names appear in team performance, as the story asks; applicant data never does.
